{{Short description|Dutch isotope physicist}}
'''Willem Gerrit "Wim" Mook''' (10 July 1932 – 24 January 2016) was a Dutch [[isotope]] physicist.

== Life and career ==
Mook was born on 10 July 1932 in [[Groningen]].<ref name=rug>{{cite web|author= |url=http://hoogleraren.ub.rug.nl/?page=showPerson&type=hoogleraar&hoogleraar_id=1440&lang=en |title=Willem Gerrit (Wim) Mook, 1932 |publisher=University of Groningen |date= |accessdate=27 January 2016}}</ref> He obtained his doctorate at the [[University of Groningen]] in 1968, with a dissertation titled: ''Geochemistry of the stable carbon and oxygen isotopes of natural waters in the Netherlands''. He was a lecturer of [[isotope]] physics at the same university between 1975 and 1979. Starting the next year he was professor of isotope physics, until his retirement in 1997.<ref name=rug/> From 1986 he also served as professor at the [[VU University Amsterdam]].<ref name=rug/>

Mook was director of the [[Royal Netherlands Institute of Sea Research]] (NIOZ) from 1990 to 1996.<ref name=nrc>Family notices in ''[[NRC Handelsblad]]'', 27 January 2016</ref>

In 1985 he became a member of the [[Royal Netherlands Academy of Arts and Sciences]].<ref name=rug/><ref>{{cite web|author= |url=https://www.knaw.nl/nl/leden/leden/4566 |title=Mook, Prof. dr. W.G. (Wim) |publisher=Royal Netherlands Academy of Arts and Sciences |date= |accessdate=27 January 2016}}</ref>

He died on 24 January 2016 in [[Haren, Groningen|Haren]].<ref name=nrc/>
